full_judgment: 6. As against this, the defendant has preferred the appeal to this Court Mr. Ahmadur Rahman Khan appearing for the appellant pointed out that the learned trial Court on consideration of the evidence of P.Ws. 2 and 3 concluded that these witnesses could not remember anything in details. The learned Advocate contended that the judgment of the appellate Court below is not a proper judgment of reversal because it suffers from non-consideration of evidence. It was further submitted that exhibit 2 is a fraudulent document and in that view of the matter the suit was not maintainable.
